# openstatus_http_monitor (Resource)

Manages an HTTP monitor.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "openstatus_http_monitor" "api" {
  name        = "API Health Check"
  url         = "https://api.example.com/health"
  periodicity = "5m"
  method      = "GET"
  timeout     = 30000
  active      = true
  regions     = ["fly-iad", "fly-ams", "fly-syd"]

  headers {
    key   = "Authorization"
    value = "Bearer token"
  }

  status_code_assertions {
    target     = 200
    comparator = "eq"
  }

  body_assertions {
    target     = "ok"
    comparator = "contains"
  }

  open_telemetry {
    endpoint = "https://otel.example.com/v1/metrics"

    headers {
      key   = "X-Api-Key"
      value = "secret"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Monitor name.
- `periodicity` (String) How often the monitor runs.
- `url` (String) URL to monitor.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the monitor is active.
- `body` (String) Request body.
- `body_assertions` (Block List) Body assertions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--body_assertions))
- `degraded_at` (Number) Degradation threshold in milliseconds (0–120000).
- `description` (String) Monitor description.
- `follow_redirects` (Boolean) Whether to follow redirects.
- `header_assertions` (Block List) Header assertions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--header_assertions))
- `headers` (Block List) Custom HTTP headers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--headers))
- `method` (String) HTTP method.
- `open_telemetry` (Block, Optional) OpenTelemetry exporter configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--open_telemetry))
- `public` (Boolean) Whether the monitor is publicly visible.
- `regions` (Set of String) Regions to monitor from.
- `retry` (Number) Number of retries (0–10).
- `status_code_assertions` (Block List) Status code assertions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--status_code_assertions))
- `timeout` (Number) Timeout in milliseconds (0–120000).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Monitor identifier.
- `private_location_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the private locations that run this monitor. Managed from `openstatus_private_location.monitor_ids`.
- `status` (String) Current monitor status.
